$comment: Unit traits (G-62, Kev 2026-10-09): one always-on rule per unit. `traits` defines each trait: its name, its one-line text and its numbers. A {key} in the text is filled from the trait's own numbers; {band} is the unit's first roll window. `evolutions` (heroId/evolutionId) and `enemies` (display name) say who has which. Who may have one: every hero evolution, every elite, and in Mantle Hunt every regular and elite unit (Pack Rage). Base heroes, every other regular unit, tanks, supports and bosses have none. The `traits` gate checks that rule, that every trait is used, and that every number printed is the number the engine applies.

exposed.name: Exposed
exposed.text: Its area attacks deal +{amount} to marked enemies.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.text: After rolling {band}, its next leech heals {pct}% more.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.text: When hit while taunting, its spike deals +{amount}.

glacialArmor.name: Glacial Armor
glacialArmor.text: At round start, gains {amount} shield per frozen enemy.

dugIn.name: Dug In
dugIn.text: At round start, gains {amount} shield while below half HP.

triage.name: Triage
triage.text: Its heals restore +{amount} on the lowest-HP ally.

overflow.name: Overflow
overflow.text: Its healing past full HP becomes shield.

redline.name: Redline
redline.text: +{amount} damage on every attack while you have {protocol} or more Protocol.

ghostSignal.name: Ghost Signal
ghostSignal.text: Jams it applies from cloak last {rounds} extra round.

silentKill.name: Silent Kill
silentKill.text: An ambush that kills its target keeps the cloak.

cleanKill.name: Clean Kill
cleanKill.text: When it kills, the lowest-HP enemy becomes marked.

static.name: Static
static.text: At round start, the highest enemy die drops by {amount}.

zeroDay.name: Zero Day
zeroDay.text: Enemies it rewrites take +{amount} damage until the rewrite ends.

backup.name: Backup
backup.text: When an ally is hit, gains {amount} shield.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.text: When it dies, deals {amount} damage to each hero.

barbed.name: Barbed
barbed.text: Heroes that hit it take {amount} damage.

litany.name: Litany
litany.text: At round start, the lowest enemy die rises by {amount}.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.text: The first hit against it each battle is negated.

compel.name: Compel
compel.text: Its roll penalties last {rounds} extra round.

packRage.name: Pack Rage
packRage.text: When an ally dies, gains rampage.
